libraryDefinition.name: Supplier drift after its major customer's strong earnings (SUE top 30%, positive reaction day)
libraryDefinition.explain: LINKS: a supplier's own 10-K (filed before the day, point in time; the supplier's latest 10-K must show it, at most 400 days old) names a US-listed customer (one of the 1,000 most traded stocks at a quarter start; its CIK and legal name from Massive) in a major-customer revenue sentence with a first percentage >= 10%; strict names (legal name minus corporate form, no acronyms, no person names, no hand aliases), found by EDGAR full-text search and verified on the document text; 50 random links hand-checked before any return. EVENT: the customer reports (Nasdaq calendar) with SUE = (actual - consensus EPS) / close in the top 30% of liquid reports of the previous 63 sessions (ANOM-SUE definition). ENTRY: the supplier at the next open after the customer's reaction session, if close 3 USD+, 20-day traded value 2M USD+, and no own report (Nasdaq calendar or 10-Q/10-K filing) in sessions r-4..r+20. EXIT: 20 sessions, 20% stop. One open trade per stock. Placebo: the same supplier on a random non-event session of the same quarter (seed 28), reported as a yardstick. AND the customer's reaction-session return > 0. Paper(s): Pandit, Wasley & Zach (2011) Information Externalities along the Supply Chain: The Economic Determinants of Suppliers' Stock Price Reaction to Their Major Customers' Earnings Announcements, Contemporary Accounting Research 28(4); Cohen & Frazzini (2008) Economic Links and Predictable Returns, Journal of Finance 63(4); Menzly & Ozbas (2010) Market Segmentation and Cross-predictability of Returns, Journal of Finance 65(4).

libraryDefinition.explain: RULE (squad24-core.mjs header, exact): an 8-K listing Item 1.01 whose main document / EX-99 / EX-10 names, as a counterparty in a deal sentence that is not a financing sentence (credit / loan / underwriting / sales-agent / lender wording), a company on a FROZEN list of the 100 largest US-listed companies by market value at the latest quarter start (data/squad24-megacaps.json, CIK + legal name + up to 2 hand-written aliases, SHA-256 in the header; never-listed namesakes such as OpenAI excluded, SpaceX only after its own 2026 listing; an alias followed by an extra name word such as a country or "International Ltd" fails). Buy the next open; sell the close of session 10 or at a 25% stop. Costs 0.8% / 1.2% and a 2%-each-way slippage version (an extra gate). Yardsticks: the average 1-10 USD stock on the same days; the same stock on other days; per year vs SPY. Information: the average liquid stock; a first-open variant.

sourceRule.name: Novy-Marx profitable value (gross profit / assets rank + book / market rank, 50 of the 500 largest, quarterly)

source.who: Robert Novy-Marx (2013) The other side of value: the gross profitability premium, JFE 108(1) (Alpha Architect summary)
source.claim: profitability 0.31%/month, value 0.41%/month, combined 0.71%/month long-short 1962-2010 (Sharpe 0.85); works "even among the largest, most liquid stocks"
source.oos: later: value lost ~60% 2017-2020 while profitability held; the library's all-stock ANOM-GP was rejected

sourceRule.rule: Quarterly review. Universe: the 500 largest, financials out. GP/A = TTM gross profit (or revenue - cost of revenue) / latest total assets; B/M = latest stockholders' equity / market value; both known and equity > 0. Score = percentile rank of GP/A + percentile rank of B/M (each 0..1 within the eligible set); hold the 50 highest (ties: higher GP/A), equal weight; sold when no longer among the 50.
sourceRule.deviations: Long only (the paper is long-short); quarterly instead of annual / monthly; a fixed 50 instead of the top tercile / decile.

libraryDefinition.name: Novy-Marx profitable value (gross profit / assets rank + book / market rank, 50 of the 500 largest, quarterly)
libraryDefinition.explain: RULE: Quarterly review. Universe: the 500 largest, financials out. GP/A = TTM gross profit (or revenue - cost of revenue) / latest total assets; B/M = latest stockholders' equity / market value; both known and equity > 0. Score = percentile rank of GP/A + percentile rank of B/M (each 0..1 within the eligible set); hold the 50 highest (ties: higher GP/A), equal weight; sold when no longer among the 50. DEVIATIONS from the published method: Long only (the paper is long-short); quarterly instead of annual / monthly; a fixed 50 instead of the top tercile / decile. Common (squad16-core.mjs header): universe = the N largest US operating companies by point-in-time market value at each review close (Squad 5 / 11 / 14 market value: SEC share count known 30+ days earlier x the close, dead stocks included, the historical Form 3/4/5 ticker map, US domicile, one ticker per company); SEC XBRL facts filed before the review only (TTM periods ended within 200 days). Baskets: bought at the next open after the review that selects them, held while selected, sold at the next open after the first review that drops them; sleeve rules hold each pick one year. Judged per REVIEW PERIOD (each stock held from the open after review j to the open after review j+1 is one trade, as Squad 5 periodPieces), so holdings still open today do not bias the result; every period pays the full 0.8% cost (1.2% stress); the portfolio test pays only real trades. Judged once (first complete run frozen in data/squad16-lab.json firstRun) with hold-core judgeHold on both halves (entry before / from 2024-01-01): > 0 after 0.8% and 1.2%, better than the average liquid stock at the same moments (both capped at +300%, AUD-1), better than the same stock held as long on its other days, > 0 without its 2 best, 20+ trades and 3+ blocks per half, block t >= 2.5, return per year of capital tied up above SPY on the same days in both halves; baskets also as one account (0.4% per side) vs SPY and SPUS per half (gates scan.mjs).

protocol.selection: Mechanism/source/data feasibility before new outcome calculation. Prior published/frozen results already exist; this is retrospective independent evidence review, NOT new untouched confirmation.
protocol.ruleChanges: NONE; actual existing source parameters/entries/exits/holds preserved; M03 has no adopted rule and cannot run a fabricated trading test.
protocol.variants: Twenty triage candidates are not twenty independent trials/families. Report overlaps/variants/search burden; no new proof threshold or rescued verdict.
protocol.cohort: All retained rows for each selected exact rule; if tail-capped/incomplete or generated after firstRun, label retained monitoring/tail, never frozen full-cohort replication. Original firstRun and correctedRun stay separate.
protocol.timeSplit: Use original rule split/hold; no alternative split chosen from results. No available unseen confirmation sample is presumed.
protocol.analysis: Mean/median/losses/worst/stress/drop-top2/drop-top5percent/concentration/date-customer-symbol clustering, original controls and original verdicts. Portfolio concurrency is lower-bound for incomplete cohorts; no feasible-return/DD claim without actual prices/marks.
protocol.costs: Whole shares,1000USD reference,3USD per executed order/side. Preserve original model cost/slippage/gap rules and exact order count. USD entry/exit/BBO/halts/no-fill/settlement absent => executable economics NULL; no invented prices. Fee scenarios/affordable-trade bounds are labelled mathematical sensitivity, never fills.
protocol.control: Existing untouched market/sector/average-stock/same-stock/customer placebo controls; preserve original cost-convention differences. Missing controls NULL, no softening or selected winners.
protocol.stopping: No tuning, no new acquisition, no original verdict overwrite, no live promotion; STOP failed exact versions. INCONCLUSIVE for missing evidence. Promising raw model => only bounded next evidence, never BUY.
protocol.provenance: Original paper vs owner hypothesis vs primary business fact vs replicated model result kept separate. Provider historical fundamentals/identity/corporate actions/acceptance clocks not assumed point-in-time. No current ZAD backfill into historical outcomes.
protocol.budget: One batch-specific offline analysis, maximum2hours engineering/analysis plus focused review; no monetary budget, market calls, workflow action or task changes.
protocol.release: Interrupt research for an actual attended Stage1/recovery handoff; Stage2 final/writer gates unchanged. No production writes, source promotion, private quote activation or orders.
